subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should OpenClaw land final-answer candidate lifecycle as a bounded Activity surface now, or fold it into the broader native Codex progress UX tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven on the old Control UI path, but current main has a new Activity architecture and the remaining choice is product/UX ownership rather than a purely mechanical code defect.

options.title: Rebase Bounded Activity Slice
options.body: Accept `answer_candidate` as safe Activity metadata and port the PR to current `ui/src/pages/activity/*` plus the current Codex projector before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Codex Progress
options.body: Use this PR's proof and tests as input for the canonical native Codex progress issue instead of landing a standalone candidate surface.

options.title: Decline Candidate Activity
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want final-answer candidates exposed as Activity entries.

recommendation.title: Rebase Bounded Activity Slice
recommendation.body: Accept `answer_candidate` as safe Activity metadata and port the PR to current `ui/src/pages/activity/*` plus the current Codex projector before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Activity architecture and Codex projector history make this the best available routing owner for the product-shape decision.
